closure_rule: bridge-only-1: only edges listed in a scenario's bridges array can be closed. Pack 1.1.0 introduced this rule and the v2/v3 scenario IDs.

scenarios.title: Riverside
scenarios.blurb: Manage an outbreak across a district with a busy central interchange.

scenarios.title: Twin Districts: The Island Outpost
scenarios.blurb: Two forest settlements meet at a small island outpost, reached by two separate bridges. Decide where to investigate, protect, and close bridges.

scenarios.title: Lifeline: The Cost of Containment
scenarios.blurb: Both depots sit on one side of a dry ravine. Every bridge closure also changes where help can travel.

scenarios.title: Crossfire: Converging Threats
scenarios.blurb: Shared junctions in broken woodland connect response routes from opposite sides of the district.
